purpose: Sanitized LSEG Tick History extraction contract for the frozen G2 market-data lanes. Contains no credentials, tokens, purchases, downloads, or coverage claims.

sources.evidence: TickHistoryTimeAndSales supports the listed trade/quote fields for equity and option pipelines and uses historical instrument validation.
TickHistoryTimeAndSales request template includes bid/ask prices and sizes plus trade price and volume.
Official LSEG sample demonstrates enumerating options on an underlying and extracting option timeseries. Credential material from upstream examples is intentionally excluded.
Companion research repository provides historical PERMNO-to-RIC candidates for the same research ecosystem.

identifier_mapping.caution: Candidate RICs must be validated for the specific historical trade date. A root match alone is not a coverage claim.

method_candidates: historical/inactive RIC validation in the extraction request
option_instrument_resolution.caution: Enumerate the full listed option universe for each underlying/date before claiming strict option quote completeness.
